name: Tooltip
description: A short label or hint that appears on hover and keyboard focus.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. It receives the event handlers and aria attributes.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: A keyboard shortcut shown after the text.

props.name: side
props.description: Where the bubble appears. Default top.

props.name: asLabel
props.description: Use the tooltip as the trigger's name (icon-only buttons) instead of its description.

props.name: delay
props.description: Hover delay in ms. Keyboard focus shows it at once. Default 300.

a11y: role="tooltip", linked with aria-describedby, or aria-labelledby for icon-only triggers.
Shows on hover and on keyboard focus (not on mouse focus), hides on blur, pointer leave and Escape.
